title: People and Performance Systems
summary: Made workforce decisions more objective through utilisation visibility, performance workflows, and measurable incentive design.

projectItems.title: HRMS Optimisation for Utilisation and Performance
projectItems.summary: Enhanced workforce visibility, utilisation tracking, and appraisal governance across HR systems.
projectItems.problemStatement: Leaders had limited visibility into resource use and inconsistent performance tracking.
projectItems.solution: Built utilisation dashboards, task-tracking mechanisms, and automated appraisal workflows.
projectItems.impact: Improved allocation decisions, transparency of evaluation, and data-supported HR management.
projectItems.leadershipValue: Bridges people operations and delivery performance to improve workforce effectiveness.

projectItems.title: Performance-Linked Incentive System
projectItems.summary: An incentive framework that links contribution and operational efficiency to measurable performance outcomes.
projectItems.problemStatement: Incentive decisions were not consistently grounded in measurable operational performance.
projectItems.solution: Built metric-linked tracking, evaluation, approval, and reporting mechanisms into the operating workflow.
projectItems.impact: Improved performance alignment, accountability, and the connection between output and reward.
projectItems.leadershipValue: Demonstrates alignment of people systems with business objectives and execution quality.
